source: USDA ARS FoodData Central, SR Legacy (April 2018 release; public domain / CC0). Nutrient values from the FDC SR Legacy CSV download (FoodData_Central_sr_legacy_food_csv_2019-04-02: food.csv, food_nutrient.csv, sr_legacy_food.csv); refuse % and refuse descriptions from the SR28 ASCII files (FOOD_DES.txt Refuse/Ref_desc, WEIGHT.txt), joined by NDB number. Values cross-checked FDC vs SR28 for all 9 nutrients; 3 foods differ (see notes on kale, celery, turkey-meat). Nutrient ids: 1008 kcal, 1003 protein, 1004 fat, 1005 carbohydrate by difference, 1079 fiber, 1106 vitamin A RAE, 1162 vitamin C, 1087 calcium, 1089 iron.
retrievalNote: api.nal.usda.gov returned HTTP 429 (DEMO_KEY rate limit) and fdc.nal.usda.gov / api.nal.usda.gov were blocked by the session egress policy, so values were read from GitHub mirrors of the official USDA downloads listed in sourceUrls.

fieldNotes.per100g: Per 100 g of edible portion, raw.
fieldNotes.ediblePortion: 1 - SR Legacy refuse% / 100: fraction of the harvestForm weight that is edible.
fieldNotes.harvestForm: What the plant-yield figure is assumed to weigh; ediblePortion converts it to edible weight.
fieldNotes.alternates: Other SR Legacy entries for variants; per100g as edible portion, refusePct as published.

energy.source: Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2020-2025 (USDA & HHS, 9th ed., Dec 2020), Appendix 2, Tables A2-1, A2-2, A2-3 (pp. 139-141). Values are Estimated Energy Requirements from IOM 2002/2005 EER equations with reference heights and healthy weights (adult reference man 5 ft 10 in, 154 lb; reference woman 5 ft 4 in, 126 lb).
energy.retrievalNote: Official URL too large for the fetch tool (32 MB) and dietaryguidelines.gov blocked from the shell; read from a byte-identical copy (same 32,157,287-byte size, PDF metadata: Author "U.S. Department of Agriculture and U.S. Department of Health and Human Services", created 2020-12-23) at https://github.com/Desso-zx/NutriChat/blob/main/Data/Dietary_Guidelines_for_Americans_2020-2025.pdf, sha256 ceea04ce1a7c13a95a170f3548ed3926ad6dd49599bd730fb58bc9c02711d16e.

activityDefinitions.sedentary: only the physical activity of independent living
activityDefinitions.moderatelyActive: physical activity equivalent to walking about 1.5 to 3 miles per day at 3 to 4 mph, in addition to independent living
activityDefinitions.active: physical activity equivalent to walking more than 3 miles per day at 3 to 4 mph, in addition to independent living

1-3.note: DGA Table A2-2 starts at age 2; age 1 is in Table A2-1 (toddlers 12-23 months, no activity levels: 800-1,000 kcal). Band values here cover ages 2-3 only.

energy.bandNote: byBand min/max/mean are computed from the DGA byAge rows that fall inside each DRI age band; mean is rounded to the nearest kcal and is a derived figure, not a DGA number.

pregnancyLactationDelta.note: Table A2-3: change vs prepregnancy needs, for women with a healthy prepregnancy weight.

rda.source: National Academies Food and Nutrition Board DRI summary tables, as reproduced in Dietary Reference Intakes for Sodium and Potassium (NASEM 2019), Appendix J, NCBI Bookshelf NBK545442.
notes: Protein, vitamin A, vitamin C, calcium and iron are RDAs; total fiber is an AI (Adequate Intake).
Vitamin A as RAE: 1 RAE = 1 ug retinol, 12 ug beta-carotene, 24 ug alpha-carotene or 24 ug beta-cryptoxanthin.
Protein RDA is based on g/kg of reference body weight (0.8 g/kg for adults).
Children 1-3 and 4-8 values apply to both sexes.
